productSet.title: NOTICE Storage Room Temp Sign, Keep at 58 Degrees, for Sweet Potato Farms and Packing Sheds, 8x12 Premium Extra-Thick Rust-Resistant Aluminum Sign by CGAP Safety
productSet.descriptionHtml:
Keep at 58 Degrees. This NOTICE sign from CGAP Safety reads: STORAGE ROOM / KEEP AT 58 DEGREES. Written for sweet potato farms and packing sheds.

Why this sign matters

Puts the rule for the storage room temp in plain words right where people need it, so it gets followed instead of ignored.

Where to post it

On the storage room door.

Who orders it

Growers and shed managers.

Premium extra-thick, rust-resistant aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. A sign supports your site rules; it does not replace training or supervision.
